info.title: Image Convert
info.summary: Convert, resize, crop and analyse images: WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG and GIF.
info.description: Accepts an upload or a public URL, applies EXIF orientation, resizes with your chosen fit, optionally rotates, flips, blurs, sharpens or grayscales, strips all metadata and encodes to the format you ask for. `info=1` returns dimensions, format, transparency, orientation and a five-colour dominant palette instead of an image.

post.description: Send the image as a `multipart/form-data` upload named `file`, or pass `url`. Images over 25 megapixels or 8000 pixels on a side are refused before decoding. SVG input is not accepted. Metadata is never carried over to the output.

source.description: Dimensions, format, byte size, EXIF orientation, animation and alpha of the input.

output.description: Dimensions, format, byte size and quality of the result. Absent with `info=1`.

colors.description: With `info=1`: `dominant` list of `{hex, share}` and the `average` colour.

image.description: With `resp=json`: hosted link valid for 24 hours.

file.description: The image as a multipart upload. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or BMP, up to your plan's upload limit.

url.description: Public URL of the image instead of an upload.

format.description: Output format: `webp` (default), `avif`, `jpeg`, `png`, `gif`, or `keep` to keep the source format.

width.description: Target width in pixels, up to 8000. Omit to derive from the height.

height.description: Target height in pixels, up to 8000. Omit to derive from the width.

fit.description: `inside` (default, shrink to fit, never enlarge), `cover` (fill and crop), `contain` (fit with padding, see `background`) or `fill` (stretch).

background.description: Six hex digits used to flatten transparency and to pad `contain`. JPEG output is flattened on white when unset.

rotate.description: Clockwise degrees, 0 to 359. EXIF orientation is always applied first.

info.description: `1` returns metadata and dominant colours as JSON without producing an image.

resp.description: `image` streams the bytes with `X-Image-Width` and `X-Image-Height` headers. `json` stores the result for 24 hours and returns its link with the metadata.

x-status-codes.title: Bad request
x-status-codes.description: No `file` upload and no `url` were sent, or a parameter is invalid.

x-status-codes.title: Too large
x-status-codes.description: The upload exceeds your plan's limit or the image exceeds 25 megapixels.

x-status-codes.title: Unsupported
x-status-codes.description: The bytes are not a JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or BMP image.

x-status-codes.title: Unauthorized
x-status-codes.description: The Authorization header is missing or the key is not recognised.

x-status-codes.title: Forbidden
x-status-codes.description: The key is not licensed for this product.

x-status-codes.title: Too many requests
x-status-codes.description: The per-minute rate or the plan quota is exhausted. Retry after the seconds given in `Retry-After`.
